description.value:
Cost 1 charge of Ghost-Static

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Make a ranged Strike against the target's AC using your class DC's attack modifier. On a hit it takes 1d6 electricity damage, or 2d6 on a critical hit. This damage increases by 1d6 at 5th, 11th, and 17th level, as your Rig does.
